calls.thesis: Likes it at this price and plans to buy a little more over time: FormFactor's HBM/memory test and probe-card demand rises with HBM complexity, it has multiple design wins at large fabless XPU makers, and optical/CPO test is an added leg (management guided 2026 CPO revenue significantly above $20m). He previously sold in the 150s and currently does not own it.
calls.price_at_call: Around $105; forward P/E ~33 on high-end estimates for the next ~5 months
